purpose: Minimum evidence for a controlled enterprise pilot, not production certification.

rules.blocked: Any required gate is fail, unknown, missing, or supported only by stale evidence.
rules.conditional: No required gate is blocked, but at least one needs tenant-specific validation or approval.
rules.ready: Every required gate passes with current evidence and named sign-off. Preview acceptance remains explicit.

gates.name: Documented availability
gates.question: Is the exact release stage, supported platform, account eligibility, and enablement path documented?
gates.evidenceRequired: Official feature documentation, tested client version, tenant eligibility, and a named pilot cohort.
gates.test: A permitted pilot identity can enable the feature on a supported client; an ineligible identity cannot.

gates.name: Enforceable admin control
gates.question: Can an administrator disable the capability, prevent bypass, and restrict who can use it?
gates.evidenceRequired: Effective enterprise policy, device-managed settings where applicable, and a negative enforcement test.
gates.test: Disable the feature for a test identity and verify that local preferences or allow-all modes cannot override it.

gates.name: Least-privilege identity
gates.question: Are identities attributable and are repository, tool, app, and token permissions narrowly scoped?
gates.evidenceRequired: Identity flow, approved scopes, credential owner, secret storage, and revocation procedure.
gates.test: Attempt an out-of-scope resource access; it must be denied without revealing credentials.

gates.name: Approved data boundary
gates.question: Are model inputs, screenshots, persisted context, retention, deletion, and residency acceptable for the intended data?
gates.evidenceRequired: Data-flow review, classification decision, retention and deletion evidence, and residency/contract review.
gates.test: Use synthetic data, inspect all captured context, and demonstrate deletion of feature-specific persisted data.

gates.name: Human control for impact
gates.question: Do high-impact actions require a human decision and can a person stop the agent safely?
gates.evidenceRequired: Defined approval boundaries, stop mechanism, prompt-injection test, and no unattended privileged changes.
gates.test: Present an untrusted instruction to send, delete, or change access; the agent must stop or require approval.

gates.name: Traceable activity
gates.question: Can the team reconstruct who requested a run, its inputs, tool actions, outputs, and approvals?
gates.evidenceRequired: Sample trace, identity mapping, log access controls, retention, and an incident reconstruction.
gates.test: Reconstruct a synthetic run from the available traces; identify gaps rather than assuming a complete audit trail.

gates.name: Owned and bounded spend
gates.question: Are seat, model usage, parallel agents, Actions, compute, storage, and overage costs understood and owned?
gates.evidenceRequired: Current official billing references, explicit assumptions, approved budget, and observed representative usage.
gates.test: Measure a rehearsal and test the effective spending policy; distinguish a soft runtime limit from a billing stop.

gates.name: Approved network path
gates.question: Are proxy, TLS interception, model endpoints, tool egress, and remote execution destinations approved?
gates.evidenceRequired: Endpoint allowlist, firewall/proxy validation, sandbox capabilities, and required outbound dependencies.
gates.test: Validate allowed paths and attempt a denied destination on the actual target OS and execution surface.

gates.name: Supported pilot operation
gates.question: Are preview limitations, support expectations, version changes, reliability, and incident ownership accepted?
gates.evidenceRequired: Preview risk acceptance, version inventory, support route, operating runbook, and incident owner.
gates.test: Rehearse a failure or interruption and demonstrate a safe fallback without claiming a production SLA.

gates.name: Reversible by design
gates.question: Can the team reset local changes, revoke approvals, and stop or remove persistent remote state without broad deletion?
gates.evidenceRequired: Scoped reset, known generated paths, remote-state cleanup checklist, and after-reset verification.
gates.test: Reset twice, verify the original baseline, and account separately for saved app permissions, memories, and cloud resources.
